facts.fact: MDF, the implementer, says that e-Foncier Benin, built with ANDF since 2018, records land rights, with 222,463 people holding recorded rights and 2 municipalities and 387 villages almost fully registered between 2021 and 2025.
MDF says e-Foncier Benin is a digital system that maps plot boundaries and links them to legal records, with 491,293 parcels mapped in 2021-2025.

systems.owner: ANDF (Agence Nationale du Domaine et du Foncier)

facts.fact: MDF says e-Foncier Benin records land rights for part of the country, with 491,293 parcels mapped, 222,463 people with recorded rights and 2 municipalities and 387 villages almost fully registered in 2021-2025, and a national cadastre for all 77 communes is the aim.

BEN.note: Municipal officials are trained on the land system, but nothing is stated on office connection.
